name: Cacao Atelier
description: Luxe chocolatier template for bonbons and gift boxes, with liquid chocolate dripping over the hero and 3D flip cards for tasting notes.
features: Animated SVG chocolate drip that pours down from the header into the hero
Six 3D flip cards with illustrated bonbons and tasting notes, keyboard accessible
Gift box shop cards with illustrated cases and prices
Bean-to-bonbon process, testimonials, care FAQ and a working enquiry form
signature: Liquid chocolate drips down over the hero; bonbon cards flip in 3D to reveal tasting notes
